title: Vii's Unnecessary Items
description: This mod adds a buncha unnecessary stuff! Have fun!
body:
_MADE USING MCREATOR!_
## This mod has three planned paths revolving around achievements:

To first get the starting achievement you must enter the overworld from another dimension to unlock the achievements for the DiegoNate path, the Regular path (with normal unnecessary items) & the Silly path.

## Currently added items (Regular Path only):

Iron Sword tools (regular tools crafted using iron swords)

Iron Sword Sword tools (regular tools crafted using iron sword swords)

Iron Sword Sword Sword Armour (armour crafted using iron sword sword swords)

Amethyst armour & tools

**The DiegoNate path has some blocks & enchants, while the Silly path has 1 biome, but there will be more to come**
